parity_bugs_found_and_fixed.title: xsl:value-of/xsl:copy-of atomic casts appended an empty text node when the cast string was empty
parity_bugs_found_and_fixed.fix: skip append_text_node when the first byte is NUL, matching upstream xsltValueOf/xsltCopyOf `if (value[0] != 0)`

parity_bugs_found_and_fixed.title: XPath child axis included the DTD node on DOCTYPE documents (count(/root)=2, string(/root)=empty)
parity_bugs_found_and_fixed.fix: skip XML_DTD_NODE (type 14) in child_axis, matching upstream xmlXPathNextChild/xmlXPathNextChildElement

parity_bugs_found_and_fixed.title: xsltproc XML_PARSE_NOCDATA was 1<<4 (which is XML_PARSE_DTDVALID) instead of upstream 1<<14
parity_bugs_found_and_fixed.fix: corrected the constant; --novalid/--nodtdattr replacement paths now use the true NOCDATA bit

courts.abi_probes: all byte-identical PASS (data_globals, globals_threading, security_limits, tree_structure, callback, catalog, encoding, error, reader, save, writer, xpath, xslt families)

final_verdict: PASS — Phase 11.2 sealed. Every compatibility-sensitive module (127/127) now carries the seven forensic-custodian commentary dimensions, grounded in the atlas fact sheets; the CUSTODIAN-COMMENTARY-0001 court makes the acceptance machine-checkable and reproducible. Two new candidate parity bugs discovered while writing the commentary (R-000172, R-000173) and one constant error were fixed and court-covered, bringing the CLI corpora to xmllint 48 and xsltproc 21 byte-identical cases. Residual ledger: 73 FIXED / 2 OPEN (R-000157, R-000168 bounded obligations). A future maintainer can now reconstruct the why from the source without chat archaeology.
